Traders Urge Rollback of UPI Charges Amidst Merchant Discount Rate Changes

A trade body representing approximately 6 crore traders has urged Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to roll back proposed charges on UPI transactions. Effective October 15, eligible UPI transactions exceeding Rs 2,000 will incur a 0.4% Merchant Discount Rate (MDR). This change has reportedly disappointed traders. For UAE-based NRIs, UPI transactions will remain free of customer fees, though certain merchant payments will attract charges.
